title: The Neon GitHub integration - Neon Docs
description: The Neon GitHub integration connects a Lakebase Postgres project on Neon to a GitHub repository by installing a GitHub App that stores a NEON_API_KEY secret and NEON_PROJECT_ID variable in the repo. GitHub Actions workflows use these to create a database branch when a pull request opens and delete it on close. Choose this page to install the integration, add the sample branching workflow, or build custom workflows with the create-branch, delete-branch, schema-diff, and reset-branch actions. Also covers disconnecting a project, removing the integration, and example apps for Vercel, Cloudflare Pages, and Fly.io preview deployments.
